caption: The drawing depicts a side profile of a dog, rendered in pencil or graphite, positioned in a walking pose with the left front leg and right hind leg extended forward. The dog has a long, bushy tail, a slightly open mouth, and shaggy fur, particularly noticeable around the chest and legs. The outline and inner details of the dog are carefully shaded to represent the texture of the fur. The dog figure is mounted above a horizontal bar with a perpendicular support beneath its belly, suggesting it is a model or a figure used for a weather vane. The composition is centered on a plain, unembellished background of light beige or off-white paper. In the lower left corner, the name "GORDON SANBORN" is written in block letters.
title: Dog Weather Vane
